analysis_scope: Raw arithmetic quantization of cadence-resolved plane-group and recurrent-track interplanar distances. No null-hypothesis or significance-testing paradigm is applied.
controlling_result_statement: The raw interplanar-distance output forms a quantized ladder, not a continuous distribution. The organizing interval is Q = 50/3 nm = 16.6666667 nm, with occupied quarter states Delta d = Q/4 = 25/6 nm = 4.1666667 nm. Thus the resolved distances follow d_k approximately k(4.1666667 nm), or equivalently whole, quarter, half, and three-quarter multiples of Q. The recurrent tracks occupy 17.25Q, 18Q, 18.25Q, 19.75Q, 20Q, 20.5Q, 21Q, 25Q, and 28Q. The 41 reported plane-group centers occupy quarter indices 58, 68, 69, 70, 72, 73, 74, 78, 80, 81, 82, 83, 84, 86, 92, 99, 101, 105, 107, 109, 110, 111, 112, 113, 119, 132, 137, 162, 181, and 214. The densely occupied regions are 17Q-18.5Q, 19.5Q-21.5Q, and 24.75Q-28.25Q. Across the complete plane-group ledger, the largest displacement from the nearest quarter-level is 1.876 nm. The plane orientations are coupled to the ladder: the near-orthogonal family around 78-99 degrees occupies 17.25Q, 18.25Q, 19.75Q, 21Q, and 25Q, while the 7.16-degree plane occupies 28Q.

quantization.rule: d_hat = k qd, k integer; Q level = k/4
